strategy.summary: cartTotal in src/cart.js prices a cart with the bulk discount (10% at 10+ items summed over lines), the SAVE5 coupon (after the bulk discount, goods floored at $0, other codes refused) and shipping ($4.99 unless discounted goods reach $50; empty cart costs 0). Unit tests in Vitest prove each rule at its boundaries. Reading the code, bulkDiscount uses `itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount — that case is expected to fail and will be recorded as a defect.
inScope: cartTotal and bulkDiscount in src/cart.js: bulk discount, SAVE5 coupon, unknown coupon refusal, shipping threshold, empty cart
outOfScope: UI/checkout pages (the repo is a pure pricing module)
assumptions: Coupon codes are matched exactly (case-sensitive), as the code does: 'save5' is another code and is refused.
'Goods' means subtotal less bulk discount less coupon, floored at 0; amounts are rounded to cents by the module.
Tests go in a new file test/checkout.test.js beside test/cart.test.js and run under the existing `npm test` (vitest run).
openQuestions: Should coupon codes be case-insensitive (e.g. 'save5')? The ticket says any other code is refused; the code is case-sensitive and the tests follow it.

risks.description: Off-by-one at the bulk threshold: code uses > 10 while the ticket says 10 or more.
risks.mitigation: TC1 tests exactly 10 items across lines (expected-to-fail, defect recorded); TC2 keeps a passing multi-line check at 11 so summing across lines stays guarded.

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount, or shipping computed on the pre-discount subtotal.
risks.mitigation: TC4 uses amounts where the order changes the total; TC8 uses a subtotal above $50 whose discounted goods fall below it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets no bulk discount.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, the goods never cost less than $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts cost $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs 0.

defects.title: Cart of exactly 10 items gets no bulk discount
defects.description: AC1 says 10 or more items in total get 10% off. bulkDiscount in src/cart.js:22 uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items (4 + 6 at $10) is charged $100 instead of $90. The fix is `>=`. TC1 is marked it.fails.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{price:10,quantity:4},{price:10,quantity:6}]) returns 100, but 90 is expected. The it.fails test passes in counted run 0.
